thread:
Elena P: Thanks everyone for jumping into the Q&A today. Capturing the live asks and a short owner list so we have a follow-up checklist. I tried to be brief.

Raj K: Quick clarification on Dedicated GA capacity tiers 1: will there be soft limits for trial accounts?

Maya L: Short answer: yes. Trial/early customers get a capped pool for first 30 days; we'll auto-upgrade on signed committed contracts. I'll write the exact numbers and policy text.

Chris T: Ops question from the live thread: what happens to model routing if a region is degraded? Is there automatic cross-region failover or manual?

Elena P: Automatic cross-region failover is allowed but only within the same latency SLO. If latency exceeds SLO we fallback to the cheapest compatible variant in another region. We also pause canary rollouts during region incidents.

Jordan R: I'll add incident steps to the Dedicated runbook: detect region health, trigger failover, notify customers, rollback canary if running.

Zoe H: On evals: we should snapshot production prompts weekly and run regression checks. If quality drops >4% on any high-value prompt we'll trigger an alert to the product/ML owner.

Raj K: Who is product owner for the Dedicated billing flow? Need someone to review contract/sample.

Maya L: That's me. I'll post the billing blurb + sample contract clause by EOD.

Chris T: Action for infra: small batch canary plan, toggles for percent splits, and a quick manual rollback button in console. I'll PR the toggle and a short test harness.

Elena P: Owners I captured: Maya (billing/contract), Chris (canary config + console toggle), Jordan (runbook + incident play), Zoe (evals + prompt snapshots). Raj to coordinate customer comms for early trials.

deploy-bot: deploy started for infra/canary-toggle branch (sha: ab12cd3). Progress: 20% -> 60%.

Elena P: Please react or post "picked" when you take the item so we can track. Also I'll draft announcement copy once PRs and runbook are in.

Maya L: Picked 1 billing draft is up: https://redwood.internal/docs/dedicated-billing-draft (will finalize tonight).

Chris T: Picked 1 PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/412. Includes toggle and rollback endpoint.

Jordan R: Picked 1 runbook PR in review, will add links to paging matrix.

Zoe H: Picked 1 uploading initial prompt set to evals infra now.

Elena P: Thanks. I'll compile these into the all-hands followup and ping product comms for the announcement window. :thumbsup:
